parameters.query:
SELECT p.PlantName, SUM(f.OutputBoxes) AS OutputBoxes, SUM(f.DefectBoxes) AS DefectBoxes,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(f.DefectBoxes) / NULLIF(SUM(f.OutputBoxes), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS DefectPct
FROM bi.FactProduction f
JOIN bi.DimPlant p ON p.PlantKey = f.PlantKey
WHERE f.DateKey = (SELECT MAX(DateKey) FROM bi.FactProduction)
GROUP BY p.PlantName
ORDER BY p.PlantName;
